title: NEW MEDIA VISUALIZATION
description: Explores principles of spatial design, interactive design and immersive storytelling as they relate to Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality (collectively referred to as Extended or X-Reality). Additional topics include the history and current applications of X-Reality technology.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
